practical.spring_festival_2027: 5–13 Feb 2027 (9 days), Lunar New Year Sat 6 Feb; makeup workdays Sun 31 Jan + Sun 14 Feb (State Council notice 5 Nov 2026)
practical.visa_us: US citizens need L tourist visa for round-trip tourism ($140, 10-year multi-entry, 4 business days standard / 2–3 express). Alternative: 240-hour visa-free transit ONLY with onward ticket to third country/region. No flights/hotels/itinerary required since Jan 2024.

practical.weather_shanghai_mar: Avg high ~14.9°C / low ~7.6°C, ~97mm rain, 12.7 wet days — changeable; light jacket + umbrella
